row.evidence: Paddle prices by transaction (5% + 50¢ per checkout transaction, or custom pricing), and dashboard team members are invited by hand on the Team page with role-based permissions; no SSO, SCIM or team-member API is documented.
row.notes: Merchant-of-record billing platform priced per transaction (Pay-as-you-go 5% + 50¢ per checkout transaction, Custom pricing via demo), with no per-seat plans, so per-user prices are null. Dashboard users are added manually (Paddle > Business account > Team members) with roles (Admin, Finance, Technical, Support, Subscription KPIs) and optional per-user 2FA. No SAML/OIDC SSO, SCIM or team-member endpoints appear on the pricing page, help centre (sitemap), developer docs (llms-full.txt) or the API reference, which covers billing resources only. Status none by absence at medium confidence. New row.

scim.notes: Not offered: team members are added manually in the dashboard; no SCIM or SSO documentation in the help centre or developer docs.

user_api.notes: The Paddle Billing API (Bearer API keys with entity.read/entity.write permissions) covers addresses, adjustments, businesses, customers, discounts, events, notifications, prices, products, reports, subscriptions, transactions and similar billing resources. No team-member, user, role or audit-log endpoints.
